fixed_point.code:
@jax.custom_vjp
def fixed_point(W, x):                    # z = tanh(W z + x), solved with while_loop
    return solve_while(W, x)[0]

def fp_fwd(W, x):
    z = fixed_point(W, x)
    return z, (W, x, z)                   # residuals: only the solution

def fp_bwd(res, z_bar):                   # implicit function theorem: solve u = z_bar + J_z^T u
    W, x, z = res
    _, vjp_step = jax.vjp(step, W, x, z)
    u = solve_adjoint(lambda u: z_bar + vjp_step(u)[2])   # another while_loop
    gW, gx, _ = vjp_step(u)
    return gW, gx

fixed_point.defvjp(fp_fwd, fp_bwd)
